title: A Passage for the Summit
author: Ines Zhou
blurb: Silas Hartwell, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
